status: bounded analytic check of sampled manufacturer high-angle average luminance
source_format: EULUMDAT quadrant symmetry, flat 510 x 510 mm emitting aperture, cd/klm intensities
angular_sampling: C=0..90 by 2 degrees, gamma=65..89 by 1 degree; quadrant symmetry extends remaining azimuths. No between-sample maxima claim.
horizontal_endpoint_limitation: Declared flat aperture has zero projected area at 90 degrees while measured file intensities are slightly nonzero. No finite luminance or complete 65..90-degree conformity claim is inferred for this endpoint.
DSE_design_basis: EN 12464-1:2021 5.9.2 Table 7 Case A, positive-polarity ordinary office screens. Adopt 1500 cd/m2 for medium-luminance screens; screens vertical or tilted <=15 degrees. Matte worktops and screen orientation still required to reduce reflections.
scope: Independent sampled photometric check, not measured luminaire luminance or a substitute for room UGR calculation. Native UGR remains separately verified.
